name: hud_ui_panel_enable_word_wrap_with_rect
description: HudUiPanel::EnableWordWrapWithRect enables word wrap and copies the wrap rectangle.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40bec0 sets wordWrapEnabled at self+0x278 and copies four HudUiRect dwords to self+0x27c.
Native smoke zhud_panel_text_color_shadow_smoke calls HudUiPanel::EnableWordWrapWithRect and verifies the enable field and copied rectangle.
